name: apex-cinema
description: Apex Cinema booking platform — monorepo root. See CLAUDE.md and docs/ before making changes.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace packages/booking-core && npm run dev --workspace app
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/booking-core && npm run build --workspace app
scripts.build:functions: npm run build --workspace packages/booking-core && npm run build --workspace functions
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace packages/booking-core && npm run typecheck --workspace app && npm run typecheck --workspace functions
scripts.test:unit: npm run test --workspace packages/booking-core && npm run test --workspace app
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build --workspace packages/booking-core && npm run build --workspace app && npm run test:e2e --workspace app -- --grep-invert @emulator
scripts.test:e2e:emulator: npm run build --workspace packages/booking-core && npm run build --workspace functions && VITE_DATA_MODE=emulator npm run build --workspace app && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions "npm run seed:emulator --workspace functions && npm run seed:auth --workspace functions && npm run test:e2e --workspace app -- --grep @emulator"
scripts.test:emulators: npm run build --workspace packages/booking-core && npm run build --workspace functions && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions "npm run seed:emulator --workspace functions && npm run seed:auth --workspace functions && npm run test --workspace functions"
scripts.emulators: npm run build --workspace packages/booking-core && npm run build --workspace functions && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions
scripts.emulators:seeded: npm run build --workspace packages/booking-core && npm run build --workspace functions && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions --import=./emulator-data --export-on-exit=./emulator-data
scripts.seed:emulator: npm run build --workspace packages/booking-core && npm run build --workspace functions && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --export-on-exit=./emulator-data "npm run seed:emulator --workspace functions && npm run seed:auth --workspace functions"
scripts.smoke: npm run build && npm run test:e2e --workspace app -- --grep @smoke
